proposals.evidence: DEDR 864 lists Tamil eṟumpu/eṟumpi/iṟumpi, Malayalam eṟumpu/iṟumpu/uṟumpu, Kota irb, Toda ïrb, Kannada iṟumpu/iṟupe/iṟuve/irvu/irve and Kodagu urupï ant. These southern survey forms preserve the r plus labial family, with nasal clusters, cluster simplification or southern stop voicing. The same article is unqueried; this does not endorse the separately questioned Gondi ant family. Per user clarification the node denotes the full article; its displayed heading remains unchanged. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
